summary: Validated MASCI Safety Hub admin-wall + logo-fix iteration 9. Backend pytest 81/81 PASS in 11.97s — includes new test_admin_auth.py (22 tests covering login success/wrong-password/missing-password, deny-path on /inspections /meetings /jhas /incidents /daily-reports for list+single+delete, /admin/check, and public POST staying open for inspections + /api/translate) plus all 59 carry-over from iteration 8. The conftest monkey-patch (requests.api.request + Session.request) auto-attaches X-Admin-Token, and explicit deny-path tests bypass it via headers={'X-Admin-Token':''}. Frontend live-probed on the public preview URL: (1) Hub at '/' shows EXACTLY 5 tiles in spec order [hub-tile-daily, hub-tile-inspections, hub-tile-meetings, hub-tile-jha, hub-tile-incidents], 5 'Start Form' CTAs, NO 'reports on file' text, NO 'Recent activity' feed, NO counts visible. (2) hub-admin-link present in footer, href='/admin/login'. (3) /admin/login renders admin-login-form + admin-password-input + admin-login-submit. Wrong password 'wrong-password-xxx' triggers 401 + 'Wrong password' toast. Correct password 'masci-admin-2026' stores 64-char hex token in localStorage at 'masci.admin.token' and redirects to /admin with 'Welcome back, admin' toast. (4) AdminHub renders all 5 admin-tile-* with counts (Daily 2, Inspections 4, Meetings 1, JHA 1, Incidents 3), plus admin-signout-btn + 'Crew Hub' link to /. (5) RequireAdmin: with localStorage cleared, every gated path bounces to /admin/login — verified for /admin, /inspections, /meetings, /jha, /incidents, /daily, and /inspect/<id>. (6) After signing in, /admin/inspections /admin/meetings /admin/jha /admin/incidents /admin/daily all load with their new-*-btn testids visible and hub-link href='/admin' (back to admin landing, not to /). (7) Public new-form pages /inspect/new /meetings/new /jha/new /incidents/new /daily/new do NOT bounce to login and have back-link 'Hub' with href='/'. /daily/new still has 57 data-testids — full regression intact. (8) Sign out clears localStorage token (verified None) and lands on /; subsequent /admin/inspections bounces back to /admin/login. (9) MASCI lockup width audit: Hub uses w-96 = 384px (size='2xl'), AdminHub uses w-72 = 288px (size='lg'), View Daily Report uses w-96 = 384px (size='2xl') — all clearly legible with M emblem + MASCI + SAFETY + ACCOUNTABILITY·DISCIPLINE·EXECUTION + NO SHORTCUTS·NO EXCEPTIONS visible. Zero JS console errors across all probed pages.
action_items: [Optional carry-over from iter 6/7/8] /app/backend/server.py is now larger with the admin gate Depends() injected on every list/single/delete; consider splitting into routers/{admin,inspections,meetings,jhas,incidents,daily_reports,translate}.py for maintainability. Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin gate is correctly enforced: every GET list, GET single, and DELETE on inspections/meetings/jhas/incidents/daily-reports requires the X-Admin-Token header; POST endpoints + /api/translate stay public, matching the field-crew threat model.

RequireAdmin wrapper preserves the intended `from` location in router state — useful if you ever want to redirect back after login (currently it always lands on /admin which is a fine simplification).

Token storage at localStorage['masci.admin.token'] is a shared-secret pattern (correctly matches user choice 1a). Note this is NOT cryptographic auth — anyone with the password gets a 64-char token that's accepted as long as it equals what /api/admin/login minted. That is the agreed design for this MVP; no signature/expiry. Suitable for an internal office-only console.

Axios interceptor in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js attaches X-Admin-Token on every request and clears the token on 401 — so a token expiring server-side (e.g., process restart wipes the in-memory token store) cleanly logs the admin out client-side. Good UX.

MasciLogo lockup variant now sized by WIDTH (w-40/w-72/w-96/w-[28rem]) — measured live: Hub=384px, AdminHub=288px, View Daily=384px. The lockup graphic clearly shows M emblem + MASCI + SAFETY + ACCOUNTABILITY·DISCIPLINE·EXECUTION + NO SHORTCUTS·NO EXCEPTIONS at all sizes. The bug from iteration's intake (squished/illegible logo on view/print) is fixed.

Legacy URL redirects in App.js work correctly: /inspections /meetings /jha /incidents /daily and /inspect/:id /meetings/:id /jha/:id /incidents/:id /daily/:id all forward to /admin/* equivalents, so any bookmarked pre-iter9 URLs land at /admin/login if not signed in (or load the dashboard if signed in).

Field-crew flow is fully airtight: Hub → /<module>/new → submit → toast.success → back to /. No path from the public Hub leads to a record list, a record detail page, or a delete button. Crews never see counts, never see other people's records, and have no DELETE affordance — matches new requirements (2).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml` (~12s, 81/81). The conftest auto-login may take 1–2s on first call. To force a backend deny-path manually: `curl -i $REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/api/inspections -H 'X-Admin-Token: '` → 401. To force a UI deny-path in Playwright: `await page.evaluate("() => localStorage.clear()")` then navigate to any /admin/* or legacy /<module> URL — bounces to /admin/login. Public surfaces that should NEVER require auth: '/' (Hub), /<module>/new (all 5), /<module>/submit if used, /admin/login itself, POST /api/{inspections|meetings|jhas|incidents|daily-reports}, POST /api/translate. New testids added this iter: hub-tile-{daily,inspections,meetings,jha,incidents}, hub-admin-link, admin-login-form, admin-password-input, admin-login-submit, admin-tile-{daily,inspections,meetings,jha,incidents}, admin-signout-btn. Legacy testids preserved on /admin/* dashboards: new-{inspection,meeting,jha,incident,daily}-btn, hub-link, share-* dialog. Carry-over from iter 8 also still works: /api/translate ES↔EN, MapThumbnail (data-testid='map-thumbnail') in print on all 5 view pages, document.documentElement.lang flips on EN/ES toggle.
rca of the issue: No bugs identified. The 3 iter-9 deliverables are all live and validated end-to-end: (1) Logo lockup sized by width — measured 384px on Hub & ViewDaily and 288px on AdminHub, fully legible. (2) Field-crew lockdown — Hub has zero record-list visibility, zero counts, zero delete affordance, and admin gate blocks reads at the API level (returns 401 without token on every list/single/delete across all 5 modules). (3) Admin wall — shared password 'masci-admin-2026' in backend/.env mints a 64-char token via /api/admin/login, stored in localStorage, sent via X-Admin-Token, cleared on sign-out and on any 401. RequireAdmin wraps every /admin/* route, legacy URLs redirect through to /admin/* equivalents.
